scripts.typecheck:cocodex: bun run --cwd packages/cocodex-protocol typecheck && bun run --cwd apps/cocodex-server typecheck && bun x tsc --noEmit
scripts.build:gui: cd gui && bun install --frozen-lockfile && bun run build && cd .. && bun run prepare:package
scripts.prepublishOnly: bun run typecheck && bun run build:gui
